notes.title: Airmen Update 1.23.19: Anchors
notes.notes:
This week's update finalizes the tree visual updates and adds the anchor. The anchor deployer drops an anchor that sticks to terrain and prevents the ship from drifting too far away. Unlike the harpoon, the anchor's target length is set to the length of the chain when then the anchor hits terrain. The chain of the anchor can also be climbed. The anchor is unlocked by default and is now equipped on the starter ship.

Added an anchor.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Airmen 1.23.4: Cloud Update Part 1
notes.notes:
This week's update focuses on overhauling the visuals and systems that represent the clouds in game. Instead of specific locations featuring hand placed clouds, they are now procedural generated across the entire map. Additionally, instead of popping into existence, the new clouds will fade in from the maximum visibility range. The distant clouds will also have a soft edge as terrain emerges from behind them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/10b62cc77c6327f0a59b89fffa75b5ce0dc5f519.png

notes.notes:
This week's update tackles the issue of using the spawn selection options to track down players on the map. Random regions will now be hidden from selection as if occupied to reduce the reliability of the tactic from 100%. The blocked regions will rotate every 10-15 minutes. Three additional spawn point options have been added to help pad out the reduced list size and provide easier access to contracts for players who cannot afford to invest in every outpost.

notes.title: Airmen 1.22.0: Render Pipeline Update
notes.notes:
This week's update upgrades the game's render pipeline from Unity's Standard Pipeline to the Universal Render Pipeline. The new pipeline makes shader work easier than it was before and should offer a performance boost across the board. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/2c339127e2ff779c29b654682a2d833bd67a904e.png

The new pipeline brings new functionality allowing for some improvements such as radial fog and better distant clouds. At the same time, a few features are no longer properly supported such as distortion effects and screen space reflections. Almost every shader in the game had to be remade for this update along with a total replacement of post-processing so nothing will look quite the same as it did before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/9c7e8bb9db2b8f4e06495460999a1e33526dd2a8.png

This update is the culmination of 4 weeks across the year of slowly finding yet another visual that was broken or needed attention. If you notice anything suspiciously invisible, please let me know on the official Discord.

notes.title: Update 1.19.12: The Spookening Part 3
notes.notes:
The final chapter of the Spookening arrives this update adding a new themed weapon as a reward for dealing the finishing blow to the Glass Demon. The shard silo and shard cannon turret are an experimental paired weapon system. The shard silos function similarly to pigeon missiles however instead of seeking the furthest ship's engines the shard silos seek shards fired from allied ship's shard cannons. Shards fired from shard cannons deal minor damage but embed themselves into the target like a harpoon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/e861992661e512fa3b7e6760387b980918f0be20.png

The new shard weaponry is likely the most complex ship weapon in Airmen so far. The weapon will likely under-perform pigeon missiles in a damage contest but offers many unique strategies. The shard silos can be mounted horizontally and their projectiles are more easily boarded. Additionally, while the shard turret has far shorter range than the shard silos, a separate ship can fire the designating shot allowing a slower ship equipped with shard silos to stay on target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/e19f012e7eee70bc0594771a2de95bfeff668e1c.png

Remember that each impaled shard can be destroyed by damage like a harpoon. The designating shot can be destroyed by the target's crew or your own shard silos scoring accurate hits. Shard turrets are also stuck with whatever shard placement they end up with as shards can only be destroyed by damage and cannot be cleared from the turret like a harpoon.

1.19.12

Major Features
Added shard cannon turrets and silos.

Minor Features

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.19.6: Ship Chunk Shifting
notes.notes:
Many hangar systems receive under-the-hood overhauls this update adding one new visible feature: ship chunk shifting. Now, when looking at a chunk of your ship disconnected from others, pressing the ship shift keys will shift only that chunk. Once that chunk connects with another, only undoing the shift will separate the two. The entirety of the ship can still be shifted by pressing the shift buttons while no parts are moused over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/8e936e5b0d4edbf1202d1f2a3f8954ae79a31ad7.png

Skull bounties also receive a major quality of life change. When the entirety of a skull bounty carrying crew leaves the server without extracting, their skull bounty will be passed out as if destroyed. This change should make the system a lot easier to profit from without worrying about a second ship showing up to spoil your spoils after the battle is won.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/e947265c6367c57dd2579b041f802c7de32205f9.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Major Features
Added the ability to shift individual chunks of a ship in the hangar.

Minor Features
Allying another team will clear any damaged-by flags previously set between the two teams.
A ship's skull bounty will be distributed if its entire original team leaves the server without extracting.
When the mirror ghost part would block placement with the original ghost part, the mirror ghost will be hidden so you know which part orientation will be placed.
Improved mech leg handling to better go down slopes without falling over backwards.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.17.4: New Map Preview 2
notes.notes:
Progress continues on Airmen's new map adding a new region and further developing the tools used to make further regions. You can preview the new region the same as the first in sandbox by typing "/sandboxmap 1" in chat in hangar and then entering sandbox. Sandbox will randomly choose between the original spawn point or a new one in the new region.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/5e1fbb3e5b58f74f3a956e1f3f42389e36828a6a.png

As promised you can also start an expedition on the new map; however, due to the likely instability and incompleteness of the new map, it will not yet be hosted on official servers. You can enable the new map by typing "/map 1" in chat in your solo expedition lobby. You can disable the new map and return to the original map in solo expedition by typing "/map 0" in chat in your solo expedition lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/0d612044aff75b780eccf2d768b8588e8d9741ff.png

Notably, the new region features Tower Reckongale uncharacteristically close to the first region's Tsuchev Ruins. Due to the inherently limited speed of land vehicles and the detail achievable in a land heavy map, the density of the map is increasing. The archipelago constantly required long distance travel so jet streams and mag drives were used to effectively reduce the distance by increasing speed 3 to 4 fold. The new map will simply compress the distances so all vehicle types can spend the same time traveling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/05cbf7acafc26c32dab13a2e23b8c08f369ff395.png

1.17.4
Major Features
Added another new region to the new map preview.
The new map preview is now available for solo expeditions. The new map preview can be enabled by typing "/map 1" in chat while in the expedition lobby. The original map can be renabled by typing "/map 0" in chat while in the expedition lobby.

Minor Features

Previously, projectiles would explode and remain stationary in space as they fade so a crew on a fast moving ship could barely notice the effects. Now, a well place volley barrage can easily obscure an enemy captain's vision.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.8: Server Browser UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/81b53e7192de6430167f45f7eac835650d282eec.png

The overhauled server browser arrives this update phasing out one of the older pieces of user interface in the game. The new menus utilize the previously empty space and apply the user interface style of the expedition lobby making all the buttons big and obvious. Some under the hood server browser updates have also been applied that should get servers appearing in the list immediately and prevent listed servers from disappearing when a refresh occurs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/5019bdfcce9c17d3fdc9c6d175bb359f8d589d13.png

The new propeller category, heavy propellers, is now available by researching hardened gearing. These props closely adhere to the shape of the single prop with some small stat tweaks that increase mass and pressure cost for a proportional thrust gain. Both the new heavy propellers and single prop also receive shortened versions allowing ships that don't need the extended prop shaft to reduce their mass.

Added the heavy propeller and a short variant of it.

Added a short variant of the single propeller.

Added rocks to cauldron and horizon.

Game mode can now be selected in the server creation window.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.7: Terrain Improvements
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b9d879729b3d4de252672be796417fe18588eda1.png

Airmen 1.14.7 begins a process of updating the island visuals. This update improves the cliff face shader and adds large rocks to cliff faces. Since this is the start of a longer process, you will only find these large rocks at Harbor, Lookout, Atoll, and Table for now. The shader improvements also come with a performance cost and will become the new "high" for the "terrain quality" setting. The old style is now "medium" and will be default for all current players. If you want to see the new cliff face shader select "high" for "terrain quality" in the in-game settings menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9eb91201442b76aed5dcd9172527179a588fe262.png

Two small quality of life features are also added this update. Picking up or equipping a parcel now informs you of its contents on your crosshair so you don't have to remember the contents or guess when you take it from a cage. When an engine or filled pressure well is destroyed on a ship, a short engine destruction sound will play to inform your repairmen of their shame. The sound plays from the position of the destroyed part but will not play if another engine is destroy while it is already playing to prevent any audio onslaughts.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Picking up or equipping a parcel informs you of its contents on the crosshair.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.6: Daily Quests
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/bd170fa572f3cdeb709a0f485ce19ce762962d7e.png

Daily quests are now available in Airmen 1.14.6. These new quests refresh every day at midnight and are unique for each player. Currently each daily quest tier pulls from varying difficulties of contract completions, resource extraction, and other miscellaneous activities like sieges and installations. Daily quests will only update when you launch the game so you won't have to rush to complete them during late night sessions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/119eb7c4e8e1b015eff8413b2662d01c4088d750.png

Most research perquisites are removed this update to help reduce the perceived cost of completing research. While individual researches can be completed much faster than anyone could possibly exhaust the uses of the parts unlocked, players that choose to build with locked parts can set their sights on goals out of their reach and gain nothing from the things they unlock along the way. By removing the "tree" element of the research system players can start directly working to the parts they want.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Major Features

Added random daily quests.

Minor Features

Removed most perquisite researches for researches that have them.

Added two brighter rain variants: bright heavy rain and drizzle.

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.5: Cargo Mounted Part Variants and Altitude Maintainer
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/770d668144d41fbd0e02e2bd1cd585f265ae6a6d.png

Cargo mounted part variants are now available for all parts with a single beam connection face and the heavy cannon. All parts affected by this change can now be mounted on the flat surfaces of armor rather than a beam or hull root. These variant parts are automatically switched to when your crosshair passes over a surface that would match one of the variants.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c93df2a809529018cee515ebeab948e149b7850e.png

A new research "Automated Control" is now available which includes the previously unlocked-by-default roll corrector and tilt module and a new part, the altitude maintainer. The altitude maintainer is a small part assigned to a weapon group that takes control over vertical thrust to maintain the altitude of the ship when it was enabled. This should be a useful tool for cargo ships that are dragged down when overweight or submarines looking to just barely crest the waves.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b0fe08b3c81a63ef5ccd19e932c6663375bdec3d.png

Many other small changes and fixes are included in this update in response the some of the feedback coming in from new players. Remember, if you have any issues the best place to report them is the official Discord channel.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Dragoons speed across the Archipelago this update. Dragoons are a new deployable vehicle you can mount and pilot independently of your ship. These flying bikes serve as a quick form of airman transportation ideal for short range scouting, ship transfer, or resource retrieval.

notes.notes:

This update introduces the first two resource refineries: the Aetherium Hardener and Wood Petrifier. These fort exclusive parts can be loaded with raw resource parcels to output their refined varieties at a one-to-one ratio. Each refinery is uniquely shaped to encourage clever building strategies to maximize resource refining speeds. 

Resource refining should open up a new twist on late-game resource collection, hopefully turning the slowest and safest collection strategy of mining into a high yield operation. Remaining refinery varieties will be added over coming updates.

Player Forts Part 1 brings the core implementation of player forts ready to be expanded. These forts are intended as an extension of the core gameplay most accessible after existing content has been mastered. Forts come at massively higher resource costs than airships but as more content releases to supplement them, these resource costs will be alleviated by increased gains.

Currently, your fort can be used as a mobile operations center. You can spawn into the archipelago alongside your fort and even leave it on a persistent server to spawn in at later. Your fort can teleport around the islands of the archipelago and even bring along nearby ships. The teleporter can also extract the fort, its cargo, and your original home ship.

While waiting for new player fort features like resource refining and contracts, there are still plenty of ways to use your fort to maximize you stockpile gains:

Take on high difficulty contracts and teleport to their destinations with massive firepower.

Build a fort with massive cargo capacity and safely strip mine an entire island.

Teleport nearby a rival fort and wage battle across the island.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.0: Motion Blur, Extended Beams, and Upcoming Player Forts
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8e4c879e35370fcc194f0787ff741722d28eeb2e.png

Airmen 1.12.0 brings multiple new and improved optional post processing effects. You can now enable motion blur, screen space reflection, and a fixed ambient occlusion to spice up your visual experience. Additionally, you can now increase you're field of view from the default 60 degrees up to 90.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d22dec847c7c172ab2a00542d34bc108dda0c652.png

This week's update also includes some subtle changes to help get new builders moving in the right direction. Typically ship designs must pack parts together as tightly as possible for many reasons. A major reason to pack parts is to conserve the mass you'd need to connect them. The new extended beams help navigate this by allowing for a simple mass efficient way to span a long distance.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c4f8add8fdbc066c5087d7f05c62465a231c05da.png

Along with the new beams, "armor" parts have been renamed to "hull". Many players tend to over use armor early in a build and break their mass budget while still missing many critical parts. The new name should help some new builders understand the intended function of the parts. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9cf1e3aa474a318277bf5100253e583404b14ca4.png

Finally over the next few updates player air forts will appear across the archipelago. These forts will serve as later game content being geared towards extending the gameplay. Your fort will require greater quantities of resources but at the same time add utilities that increase your resource gain rates. You'll be able to teleport your fort across the archipelago using a new fort exclusive part to take advantage of its many benefits:

Spawn in with both a fort and an airship.

Refine parcels to their high density versions.

Take contracts and extract cargo.

Leave your fort on the archipelago and spawn back in at it later.

and more in future updates...

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/fe5dc8e2de043c5b17c75b8897302af6c3d6c7ce.png

Airmen 1.11.10 adds a series of new parts. Single auto turrets expand your armament options. The single auto turrets use only one cannon but can rotate 360 degrees compared to their double counterpart's 40 degrees. These turrets will help highly mobile ships take better advantage of their mobility and help lower mobility ships keep up with higher mobility ones. 

Ballast balloon options are both expanded and reworked. Their mass and ballast force is increased to match volume costs of normal ballasts. The new ballast rod balloons also follow this relationship and scale it down in size. Regular ballasts have also had their mass decreased to compete with the ease of using the ballast balloons.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8cf7c8f395442c55bb77d8618ae32d5961eab284.png

If you've grown tired of your ship disintegrating at the hands of laser drones, it can now be demolished by the new Demolition Drone. Demo drones charge directly at their target engine and attempt evasive maneuvers by bobbing up and down along the way. Unlike laser drones, demo drones will be instantly destroyed by any firearm hit. You can encounter the demo drones across the archipelago and in hunt contracts.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f1d966b05ff51c7bbc51c559a20e602284ded098.png

Finally, to ease the learning curve of the airship building system, parts preventing placement are highlighted in red. Building hitboxes are a slow part of the game to learn but an incredibly important one. This system helps a lot with the new single auto turrets as their 360 degree rotation creates a large hitbox.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c16427e65e31736f398b7af9c4037ad1f0486bd9.png

Five new parts are available this update with a new feature for unlocking them and other parts. Every research now has a "shortcut challenge". Progressing a research's shortcut reduces the research cost by up to 50%. All research shortcuts are progressed by destroying the parts unlocked from that research using ship weapons or extracting aboard a ship using them. 

There are two main goals of the research shortcut system, the first is to speed up research for players less familiar to the game. If you don't know what you are doing, collecting resources can be very slow. The secondary goal is to entice new players into combat with AI aboard their own ship or more experienced players' ships. This will hopefully get new players familiar with the very high rewards of the gold earned in combat or the resources from siege waves.

This update also brings a variety of new components. The large armored balloons further explore the durable lift options and introduce an all new connection scheme compared to existing balloons. 

The new submersibles use the same scheme and shape but expand on watercraft. Submersibles function more similarly to balloons but only in water. Submersibles do not apply a constant upward force like pontoons so combined with ballasts can easily dive below the waves.

Finally, the engine propeller combines propulsion and pressure generation into one component. The propeller has the same stats as the single prop and its built in engine covers ~60% of its pressure cost. The component is highly space efficient but pays for it in mass. Purely replacing normal propellers will likely not be an effective implementation if additional engines and the structure attaching them cannot be removed.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.10.0: Part Research and Three New Cannons
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9d4b65b96982402118fa5cad48085dfe009b6487.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.10.0 introduces a new major facet to Expedition: Part Research. Most parts in the game are now unlocked by spending resources acquired in Expedition Mode on their relevant research. Most researches unlock multiple similar parts and are chained together through branching grids grouped by component type so you'll be able to focus your efforts on branches that are most important to you.

The research system helps narrow the focus of new players on basic ship building before they are swept away by Airmen's large breadth of component options. The training wheels can slowly come off for player's familiarizing themselves with ship building. Research also provides a new potential goal for players in Expedition while attaching accomplishment to continued play. If you are not a new player and prefer to bypass the research system, you will be given a one time chance to update your research progress to cover all parts added before this update. This check relies on detecting resources in your stockpile so you will not have this option if you have never successfully completed an expedition. You can toggle on "Show Locked Parts" in the hangar settings menu if you would like to experiment in sandbox with parts you have not yet acquired.

The typical research requires around 52 parcels of resources. 52 parcels can be easily collected in just over two runs of the lightest no-cost example cargo ship. Medium airships should have no trouble carrying 52 parcels in one trip and taking on delivery contracts or siege waves can earn you resources even faster. Once you start to leverage the options of Expedition Mode, you should be completing a research every one or two successful trips.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/a9df6d54db1e05c0a969ea176b7e6f400e26dfee.png

This update removes one of the oldest components in the game: the cannon turret. Cannons have been a balancing issue for quite some time. Their dual nature as both a fixed gun and turret gun made it impossible to balance for both. To finally address this issue, the old cannon now only appears as a fixed weapon. The cannon heat-accuracy model has been reworked to complement their new role. Cannons now have a high base inaccuracy with a small increase due to heat for an overall lower max inaccuracy compared to last update.

Filling the hole in everyone's heart after losing the cannon turret are three brand new weapons that all play on my favorite aspects of the cannon turret since creation. The first is the three-shot-burst Needle Cannon. The Needle Cannon has high first shot accuracy but struggles after consistent fire. Splitting its damage across three projectiles makes it highly ineffective against armored targets but a better turret dueler than the twin cannon.

The Volley Cannon has a magazine of highly explosive arcing projectiles. The Volley Cannon excels in shorter ranges where the slow moving shots can be easily hit and overlapped for maximum damage. The more the merrier with the Volley Cannon, it's massive AoE can be easily overlapped with others.

The Breach Cannon takes the torpedo damage model into a turreted form. The Breach Cannon is highly accurate but lacks the scope of the Longneck. Shots from the Breach Cannon damage components behind the point of impacts allowing for extreme effectiveness versus tightly built airships. The tiny magazine of the Breach Cannon makes accuracy incredibly important, so be sure to stay on target.

1.10.0

Major Features

Added airship component research. Research can be unlocked from the research menu and will bar you from using parts until their related research is complete. Research is completed using resources collected in expedition mode.

Added Needle, Volley, and Breach cannon turrets.

Removed plain cannon turrets from the game. Their fixed gun variations are still available.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Bounties

Update 1.9.5 introduces player bounties with the goal of tying a reward to the PvP side of Expedition. The bounty system is carefully designed to turn those interested in PvP on each other rather than further promoting the slaughter of innocent cargo haulers. Bounties are acquired for assaulting bountyless ships and for destroying ships but only if you destroy it while a bounty is on your head. Additionally, any bounty acquired from a bountyless ship cannot increase your bounty beyond 20 gold. Ships with a bounty placed on them can extract for 50% of their bounty in gold or hunt down other pirates to gain an even larger bounty. Destroying or disarming a ship with a bounty allows you to claim 100% of the bounty as gold upon extraction. This system ensure piracy against other pirates is the most lucrative way to PvP, piracy against non pirates is the least, and players who successfully fend off a pirate attacks have something to gain.

Airships with bounties gain a black dot above their airship and any balloon paint also turns to black. This is visible to all players and the dot will be visible from greater distances when using a spyglass.

The existing bounty system might feel a bit unrewarding in its most bare bones form but I am planning to expand on the system with elements like resource rewards and a "pirate king".

Crew Orders

Crew orders while them may seem nice for high player count ships are truly geared towards users relying on AI turrets. AI gunners will obey all targeting commands and when combined with their accuracy improvement this update will exceed the effectiveness of your average human gunner. While the AI may be better gunners that is their only function and a human player can both man a gun and repair the ship between reloads so I do not expect the AI gunners to be valued over a skilled human. I'll be keeping a close eye on this relationship.

Float Stone

Float Stone is a brand new resource spread across the 5 brand new "small islands" added this update. Float Stone orbits in the sky in clusters of up to three. Float Stone can be used to craft Float Stone Shards and Bricks, heavy components that provide a massive amount of lift per volume. The heaviest ships in the game will have no problem being suspended by two float stone bricks. Float Stone lifted ships are slower for this trade off but should be able to protect themselves unlike any other ship given the free space opened up by lacking regular balloons.

1.9.5

Major Features

Added bounties for PvP. Players get bounties when they attack bountyless ships or destroy ships. Destroying bountyless ships can only increase a ship's bounty up to 20 gold. Extracting allows you to claim 50% of your bounty.

Pilots can issue targeting commands to their crew. AI gunners will obey the commands. Autoturrets will ignore targeting commands but will hold fire and reload.

Added float stone as a resource and two new components: float stone brick and float stone shard.

Minor Features

Added a tooltip when you mount the steering wheel.

Collisions are disabled for distant airships.

AI airships can target engines, propellers, weapons and balloons.

Added 5 new minor islands: Lookout, Igloo, Tooth, Floes, and Copse.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.1.2: Framerate Fixes and Expedition Balance Tweaks
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d2f8ce06c397cefe78d37d8f29f22ea05ede2cf4.jpg

As Expedition Mode becomes more stable, the way people play becomes more apparent and balance problems can be tackled. 

"Hard Points" is a new mechanic aimed a raising the durability of weapons. Most battles seem be a race to de-gun the opponent. There are no direct weapon durability buffs coming yet but the durability of their connection points would be a limiting factor without hard points.

Expedition Mode as is has been fairly uninteractive as human players just flee from fights with any amount of risk. The "Pursuit Speed Bonus" aims to allow either party to choose to fight when the match-up is close to even, rather than the faster ship playing gatekeeper.

Longnecks have proven to be a big issue in a world where there is always somewhere to run. Longneck users no longer have to experience their built-in drawback so they cannot retain their situational strength. These changes aim to force longnecks to compete in the same space as twin cannons. In a 1v1 matchup, a good shot on the longneck can still easily destroy a twin turret but the enemy captain has some more room to make the sniper's job as hard as possible.

Finally, looking towards the future, solo ship play will be getting some attention. The autoturret buff aims to improve the weapon without improving the value of a human player constantly repairing it so solo fliers can feel like autoturrets are a good choice. This won't be the end though; solo players still need a little help. I am looking into adding up to 2 AI turret gunners for ships that have no crew.

1.9.1.2

Major Features

Added "Hard Points". Hard points give hp bonuses (1/3 hard point hp up to 2000 combined) to all connected parts that are not also hard points. Bonus hp is spread evenly to connection points. All weapons besides rams are hardpoints.

Ships get a small speedboost in pursuit of other ships so ships with small mass differentials can both catch up to eachother. "Pursuit Range" begins at 450 meters.

Minor Features

Changed the extraction compass marker to a gold arrow.

Longneck range reduced to 275 (same as twins). Changed the falloff curve so longnecks deal max damage between 125m and 200m. Reduced the projectile speed by 50%. Added a small amount of base inaccuracy.

Increased all autocannon HP to 2000.

Doubled the hp of cargo pads.

Bug Fixes

Fixed not being able to kick crew members in lobby.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The expedition lobby overhaul massively improves the lobby experience. The UI is reworked with expedition in mind (rather than a team death match like escort mode) and should flow much more naturally for new players. For experienced players, you'll need a few more clicks to get into match but the new "Instant Launch" button should mitigate any extra time needed to get out on the archipelago.

This update also targets AI. Previously, AI were designed around going 1-for-1 in Escort Mode but they have a different purpose in Expedition Mode. AI needs to be a conquerable challenge that instead of destroying the player who puts up a poor fight, wounds them and moves them closer to defeat in their next battle. Fighting AI must be a risk, but the cost of a single failure should not be defeat. To adhere to this ideal, AI turret targeting aggro has been adjusted to be more evenly spread, until an opportunity to deal permanent damage arises. AI turret damage has been slashed by 50% so every fight isn't a fight for your life. Lastly, AI turret range has been extended by 30 meters to eliminate the faster forms of long-range zero-risk victory strategies.

The new UI most importantly lays the foundation for more expedition mode features the previous UI had no space for such as Contracts. Contracts are an upcoming expedition mode feature intended to give crews more concrete objectives during their expedition. Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Update 1.9.0 begins live Expedition Mode testing! During the regularly scheduled playtests, the game mode will be changed to Expedition Mode as long as the mode is functioning. Keep in mind, the frameworks supporting this game mode are not yet complete so it may not perform reliably and will certainly be missing a massive number of quality of life features. Features and fixes will be ongoing as the mode is tested.

Choose Your Airship
To captain up in expedition mode you must have enough resources to pay the build cost of your ship. A small amount of each resource will be subtracted from airship build costs so smaller ships can be built for free. The build cost of your ship is listed on a chalkboard on the left of the hangar.

If you don't have a light cargo vessel you can find one on the workshop:
Betty
Trike
Pack Ram

Fill Your Cargo Hold
Once you captain up and load into the archipelago, use the axe and pickaxe to mine resources. Different resources are found in different places. Aetherium is found at high altitudes, cyprium inside forests, and magnesite growing from large magnetic rings.

Mining isn't the only option though. Forts and some ships will be loaded with random cargo so if you can take them down, the resources are yours. Hijacked ships can also be extracted for half their build costs.

Extract
With a full cargo hold its time to cash out. Your extraction point will be marked on your HUD by a black dot. Getting within 50 meters of your extraction point will disconnect you from the game, refund your build cost for any parts not destroyed, and transfer your cargo hold to your stockpile. If you managed to wrangle an enemy airship, you will receive 50% of the build cost but will leave any other ships behind so best have a crew mate extract with it instead.

There are many things left to add/improve for expedition mode but I'm going to lay out some of the more obvious issues that may come up. 

Travelling between islands takes forever. Jet streams will be added so you can catch the wind and speed over to an adjacent land mass. The speed boost will be bigger for bigger (slower) airships.

How many resources do parts cost? Individual part costs will be made visible in the future.

The AI are so annoying. currently, AI without cargo serve purely as road blocks for other resources. The plan is to add a bounty system that transfers resources directly to the stockpiles of any crew that takes them down.

In order to fill Expedition mode with meaningful encounters, the game must be able to handle more ships on screen as players across the map battle each other or the AI. notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.4: What is Expedition Mode?
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/063ec94d59c912771d8baaeca897224b4da1acf4.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This week's update comes loaded with bug fixes and a preview of things to come. 

What is Expedition Mode?
Expedition mode is an all new open-ended way to play Airmen. Players will join a lobby, form a crew, select their airship and launch their expedition. On your expedition you'll look to fill your cargo hold with a variety of resources from wood to coal to aetherium to helicore. AI structures and airships may protect resource deposits or other human crews may look to pirate your cargo hold. The map will remain persistent as new crews join and leave and new resources and resistances will be generated as islands are encountered.

Resources
Any cargo you successfully extract with be added to your depot. Resources are spent when choosing a ship to enter expedition mode with based on what parts are used to build the ship. Bringing very light basic airships will cost no resources but the heaviest airships will require multiple successful hauls to amass their components. Successful extraction will refund a ship's resource cost based on the damage it has sustained.

Resources will come in many varieties with multiple ways to harvest each one. Components like pigeon missiles will require unique resource like pigeon eggs but simple armor, beams, and cannons will only require wood and aetherium steel. Aside from vanilla harvesting, resources can be plundered from AI cargo vessels or found in protected caches. Additionally, any captured airship can be extracted and disassembled into a fraction of its build cost.

Development
Expedition mode is a massive project and its functional components will slowly roll out individually. It began with the endless sandbox to test a larger map, then Last Crew Standing to bring that map to multiplayer and create a multi-team framework, and now the ability to chop down trees and load a cargo hold with the dropped resources. Future frameworks include mid-match connection, persistent resource tracking, run-time resource and resistance spawning, and more.

The new mode also requires much more new content on top of technical frameworks including each harvestable resource, new AI structures and airships, and new islands.

The existing game modes of Airmen will remain unaffected in the mean time unless implementing a feature into it would serve as a useful test. You will NOT be required to pay resource costs to bring ships to existing game modes.

This new mode is still a ways out and it will not be officially released until all core framework is implemented and a healthy amount of content can be enjoyed. There will likely be scheduled tests of the new mode coordinated through the Discord as it gets closer to release.

Patch Notes

1.8.4

Major Features

Added small and large cargo pads so you can gets started on your expedition mode cargo vessel.

Chopping down trees with an axe drops resource parcels that can be loaded onto cargo pads.

Minor Features

Made the hitboxes for all armor plates, roots, forks, halves, and planks consistent.

Tightened up the front rudder build and battle hit box.

Added new tree variants to Sandbox, Build Mode, High Tide, and Cauldron.

The danger zone now fully closes in Last Crew Standing.

Improved the tree destruction particle effect.

Bug Fixes

Fixed autoturrets being able to rotate too far down.

Team chat appeared to everyone in Last Crew Standing.

Fixed the railgun particle system not appearing.

Fixed /hide not working if used in a match.

Fixed grass not hiding when the option is toggled on.

Fixed weird white lines sometimes visible underwater near the origin.

Fixed a bug where the player would fall rapidly if they hit a wall after a grapple pull.

Fixed inconsistent danger zone inclusion between different heights.

Pressure Wells are an all new pressure providing component. Wells produce no pressure of their own but store any excess output for later use. They start the match charged to full capacity. Ships with powered pressure wells will not be counted out until all pressure is drained.

1.6.4

Major Features

Added pressure wells. Pressure wells absorb unused pressure and output it if the ship cannot generate enough. Pressure wells have no maximum output rate.

Minor Features

Swords attack slower but can make a quick follow up attack by holding down the attack button or clicking again after a short delay.

Ships can be piloted using an xbox controller allowing for analog turning and acceleration.

You can cycle through tool slots with mousewheel. Useables like the grappling hook are skipped.

Small performance improvment rendering clouds and engine steam.

Small performance improvement rendering ships with lots of glass, small/medium engines, or balloons.

Bug Fixes

Pigeon missiles did not prioritize targets with engines over those without.

Player grip did not reset on death in sandbox.

Fixed stabilizers not detecting collisions in the hangar.

Fixed front rudders and dragon tails clipping through terrain.

A ship's pressure status will immediately update when in submerges and unsubmerges.

Airmen update 1.5.8 brings magnetic mines to the battlefield. Mines are intended as auxiliary weapons that excel at taking down unmaneuverable targets. Players can now stand on top of mines and missiles. For easy missile mounting, jump before take off.

Changed the respawn chamber collision geometry from a box to an octagon in battle.

If a captain disconnects, their ship weapons will be disabled.

Pigeon missiles and mines will not increase grief score if they deal team damage after a short period. You will still receive warnings.

Toggling a weapon group will reload any reloadable weapons in that group.

Added 2 new cosmetics unlockable using the magnetic mine layer.

Added 2 new example ships: a light missile ship (Slash) and a medium mine layer (Outpost).

Bug Fixes

Fixed ship positions desyncing when the captain disconnects.

Fixed jumping of crosshair rotation during turret reloading.

Missiles will no longer give hit markers when hitting nothing.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The melee expansion focuses on fleshing out the melee capabilities of all the weapons. The firearms now have a tertiary bash and other melee weapons now have a secondary attack if they didn't already. The player can now  also make unarmed strikes in the unfortunate event of having no tools on hand.

Replaced the blue background of the lobby with a map view.

You can pitch down in addition to spinning background ships in the lobby.

Added an unarmed strike with 20 damage and -25 armor penetration to help wittle down spawn campers if no tools are immediately available.

Improved the smoke trail effect of carbine/revolver shots.

Added a secondary lunge to the boarding knife that does 55 damage but a long swing time and a thinner hitbox.

Added an offhand left hook to the boarding axe.

Added a hitmarker for damaging allied airships and players.

Typing /sandbox into chat enters sandbox ignoring ship requirements. This is nondefault to prevent new players from spending time testing and building a ship that violates requirements. 

Bug Fixes

Fixed a movement issue allowing players to walk on water.

The grappling hook would sometimes fire twice.

Fixed a bug that deletes challenge progress if the game closes improperly from the hangar.

Dying while falling would deal falling damage on respawn.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update goes all in on a new tool: the Grappling Gun. The grappling gun provides a new angle of attack for potential boarders allowing them to expend a tool slot for a way aboard the enemy.

Added a revolver board.

You sink slower in water and lose velocity when you submerge.

Remodeled fall damage to function based on fall speed on impact. This will allow a grappler to splat if grappling downwards so be wary.

Bug Fixes

Refixed gatling gun audio.

Fixed appearance location of build mode warnings.

Server browser match timers could not count above ~33 minutes.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.0: Water Overhaul and Performance Buff
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/67764fcdbc793321614b5513253b666512ffe0f1.png

Dive in with us on Discord for the next public playtests Friday and Saturday at 3pm ET.

Water in previous version of airmen served to do nothing other than tint your screen. Now, it gives a second life to downed airships. Balloons float and provide extra lift when submerged, engines turn off, and guns cool faster but cannot fire. Companion content for the new water features will roll out across the next week.

A new ship rendering technique brings massive performance gains of about a flat 40% off the time it takes to render any airship. This means a lot for big ship battles as larger ships take longer to render. This method exploits typical rendering procedures to function so some crazy visual bugs may occur if anything goes wrong with part shading or destruction.

1.5.0

Major Features

Huge performance buff for rendering airships (40% off normal time to render for all ships).

Balloons resist submersion in water so a downed ship will float in deep water.

Minor Features

Raised the sea level in sandbox so water interactions are easily testable.

Firearms and ship weapons do not fire when submerged.

Cannons cool off three times as fast when submerged.

Added a new escort map "High Tide", Cauldron with a higher water level.

Reworked the underwater effect.

Twin cannons gain inaccuracy much slower.

Bug Fixes

Remote client's cannons did not recoil for the host of a non dedicated server.

notes.notes:

Join us for the next public playtest today (Monday) at 7pm ET.

This update focus on airship turning. Changes eliminate physics based effects to bring rudders away from reality and closer to expectation. Other turning changes like the addition of prop turning work to make building a ship that turns well much easier.

1.4.6

Major Features

Upright rudders now apply forces as if a "ghost rudder" was in the exact opposite position. Placing rudders solely in the front or back of your ship will function the same as placing them in the front and back.

A ship with no rudders will use it's propellers to turn. Reversing functions as it would with tank controls (A/D controls pivot direction) rather than car controls (A/D controls turning circle position). A ship built with rudders that loses them will switch to this scheme.

The player's hand was visible when zoomed with the spyglass.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.1.1: Global Chat and AI Fixes
notes.notes:
1.1.1

Join us in the skies tonight at 7 PM ET and try Airmen's newest features.

This update fixes critical AI bugs and roots out more bugs in the path of getting into a match. A global chat has also been added to help get players out of the builder and into a lobby if other's are looking for crew. Firearm animations have also been tweaked for smoothness.

Added global chat. You will leave the global chat when in lobby or a deathmatch.

Added 7 more example ships and tweaked the existing ones to pass verification.

Added a new helmet for reconnaissance airmen.

Player models no longer tilt their left arm when aiming the revolver.

1st person player models hide the left hand when aiming.

Greatly reduced probability of failing to get server metadata like player count and version number.

Servers no longer compute collisions when there are no AI present. This prevents server crashes from occuring due to intense collisions.

Fixed AI immediately falling to the ground.

Fixed AI always building a stack when they circle eachother.

Possible fix to servers causing clients to crash on joining after a match.

Boarding charges did not add damage to the scoreboard.

notes.title: Airmen Update 0.65.0: New Map and Pigeon Missile Overhaul
notes.notes:
0.65.0

Major Features

Weapons below 30% HP are disabled until repaired above this threshold. Disabled weapons behave the same as weapons without sufficient pressure.

Doubled repair power. Scrap cost remains the same.

Added a new map: Ridgline. Ridgeline has 3 capture points spaced further away from eachother. The map can be swapped by the server host or by using the /map "id" command. Map ids count up from 0.

Added multiplayer sandbox gamemode. The game mode can be swapped by the server host. Infinite match time. No friendly fire. Instant respawns.

Pigeon missiles will ignore targets obscured by clouds when they search for targets shortly after launch. Smokescreen will also obscure view. Targets obsucred after launch will be lost while obsucred but cam be retargetted.

Pigeon missiles target engines.

Minor Features

Slightly reduced the dead zone size of pigeon missiles.

Smoke screens release smoke at four engines each.

Doubled duration of smoke screen.

Repair hammers can heal allies.

Harpoons pull with less power based on ship pressure.

Reduced harpoon HP to be destructable with one knife/revolver hit.

The lobby timer jumps to 30 seconds if any captain moves with less than 30 seconds remaining.

Ballast cannot lift a ship with insufficent lift (can still slow descent and maintain altitude).

Increased twin cannon armor pen 5 > 10.

Removed damage ramping of twin cannon (100% at all ranges).

Reduced armor balloon HP by 500 and increase drag coefficent by 0.2. All highly successful ship have used this balloon.

Ram momentum damage scaling reduced. Still dealing max at low velocities.

Grass is not rendered on the two lowest graphics settings.

Terrain quality adjusts more with graphics setting.

Added contents to scrap boxes that diminish as scrap is removed.

Added 20 scrap to boxes.

Finishing the activation channel on a scrap box deposits your scrap into the box. Releasing the channel early withdraws as normal.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the fuzziness of UI elements such as nametags, ship blips, and capture point blips.

Fixed a bug that allowed parts with 3+ connection points to be placed out of bounds (forcing a restart without saving).

The boarding knife goes completely off screen.

Players will not drop multiple dead bodies when dying in sandbox.
